title: Visualization of the Evolution and Transmission of Circulating Vaccine-Derived Poliovirus Outbreaks
author: Collins D. Owuor

steps.title: Install Miniconda (Anaconda)
steps.instruction: Download the Miniconda installer, add it to PATH, source the profile, and verify the installation.

substeps.instruction: Run: $ wget https://repo.anaconda.com/miniconda/Miniconda3-latest-Linux-x86_64.sh
Append to ~/.bashrc: $ echo 'exportPATH="~/miniconda3/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.bashrc
Reload the profile: $ source ~/.bashrc
Confirm installation: $ conda list (the anaconda3 folder is created as described in the installer script).

steps.title: Install Nextstrain CLI
steps.instruction: Create a dedicated Conda environment, install the Nextstrain command‑line interface, set it as the default, and verify the version.

substeps.instruction: Create environment: $ conda create -n nextstrain
Activate it: $ conda activate nextstrain
Install Nextstrain: $ curl -fsSL --proto '=https' https://nextstrain.org/cli/installer/linux | bash
Set default Conda backend: $ nextstrain setup --set-default conda
Enter Nextstrain shell in current directory: $ nextstrain shell .
Check version (must be ≥ 8.5.3): $ nextstrain version

steps.title: Verify Augur, Auspice, MAFFT, IQ‑TREE
steps.instruction: Test that the core Nextstrain tools and required external programs are correctly installed.

substeps.instruction: Show Augur help: $ augur --help
Show Auspice help: $ auspice --help
Show MAFFT help: $ mafft --help
Show IQ‑TREE help: $ iqtree --help

steps.title: Download Sabin 2 reference genome
steps.instruction: Retrieve the poliovirus Sabin 2 vaccine reference (accession AY082679) from NCBI in GenBank format.

substeps.instruction: Visit https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genbank/ and download the record with accession AY082679 as a .gb file (named AY082679.gb).

steps.title: Download VP1 gene sequence dataset
steps.instruction: Obtain all publicly available VP1 gene sequences listed in File S1 from NCBI in FASTA format.

substeps.instruction: For each accession number in File S1, go to https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/nucleotide/ and download the sequence as FASTA.
Combine all downloaded FASTA entries into a single file named polio_sequences.fasta.

steps.title: Assemble Nextstrain input files
steps.instruction: Create the set of files required by the Nextstrain pipeline, following the specifications in Table 1.

substeps.instruction: polio_sequences.fasta – the combined VP1 FASTA file from the previous step.

polio_metadata.tsv – a tab‑delimited file with at least the columns: strain, virus, date. Include additional columns (Accession, Authors, URL, Title, Journal, Paper_URL) if available, and geographic fields (continent, region, country, province, state, city) when known.
AY082679.gb – the Sabin 2 reference genome downloaded earlier.
auspice_config.json – a JSON file defining visualization settings (sample provided as File S2).
lat_longs.tsv – a tab‑separated file containing latitude and longitude for every region, country, state, and city present in the dataset (see Figure 3 for format).
colors.tsv – a tab‑separated file mapping metadata categories to hex colour codes.
